work.description: Josephus's twenty-book history of the Jewish people, completed c. 93/94 CE. Book 12 retells the Letter of Aristeas's account of the Greek translation of the Law under Ptolemy II. Loci use book with Whiston chapter or chapter.section numbering; consumers state which numbering they follow.
